{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Jude Navarro — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Jude Navarro]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Jude Navarro]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Jude Navarro]]'s Engineer services in Aurai.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Jude Navarro is '''common knowledge''' and does not require a referral from another Engineer.
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement for Jude Navarro.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Genetic Repair Meds'''
Genetic Repair Meds are Odyssey '''Goods'''.

Current material data lists them in several settlement loot pools, including:

* '''MED rooms'''
* '''STO buildings'''
* '''RES buildings'''
* '''IND buildings'''
* '''EXT buildings'''
* '''AGRI buildings'''

Medical areas are therefore an obvious place to check when searching settlements for them.

{{Tip|Only '''5 Genetic Repair Meds''' are required. Once Jude is unlocked, keep the first five you find if you intend to continue immediately into the Terra Velasquez branch.}}

Because Genetic Repair Meds are physical Odyssey Goods rather than Data, they occupy Goods storage and must be physically provided to Jude.

Once the five units have been handed over, [[Terra Velasquez]] becomes the next Engineer in the branch.

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Visit an inhabited station or settlement offering Odyssey missions.
# Look for missions specifically requiring a settlement to be '''restored''' or '''reactivated'''.
# Accept the mission.
# Travel to the designated settlement.
# Restore the settlement's power and complete any other mission objectives.
# Return and complete the mission.
# Repeat until '''10 qualifying missions''' have been completed.
# Travel to '''Marshall's Drift''' on '''Aurai 1 a'''.
# Access Jude Navarro's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Jude Navarro]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
